triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: From a clean checkout: node bin/lattice.js fails with command-not-found; node bin/proof-or-stop.js session_brief and story_get both succeed reading state from .proof-or-stop; grep for @lattice/core outside node_modules/dist/state-dir returns nothing; and signature verification passes on two named archived stories from different eras.
acceptanceBindings.note: The acceptanceClaim decomposes into four observable checks: (1) bin/lattice.js fails → CHK-006 edge:0; (2) session_brief and story_get succeed from .proof-or-stop → CHK-002 happy:0 (pre-move) + CHK-003 happy:0 (post-move); (3) grep for @lattice/core returns nothing → CHK-005 adversarial:0; (4) signature verification on two archives → CHK-003 adversarial:0. CHK-001 (migration contract), CHK-004 (config/manifest rename), CHK-007 (residue gate), CHK-008 (reversibility rehearsal) are supporting items that enable or guard the four observable checks.

diagnosticGaps.message: Scope ambiguity is triggered but no scope contract or explicit shrinkage decision is configured.

note: Acceptance binding generated by product-reviewer during intent collision review. Maps the original-intent-snapshot acceptanceClaim to the full checklist and the specific verificationIntent refs that directly witness each observable check in the claim.
